Hi Eliza — welcome, and thanks for the matrix. That looks like a great starting point.

Quick answers:
- We usually recommend one API key per service for better auditability (you can rotate per key without broad impact). For quick testing you can use a single short-lived key, but for production we advise separate keys for ingestion, UI, and scheduled jobs.
- Rotation cadence: 90 days for standard service keys; 30 days for high-privilege admin keys. We also support KMS/HSM-backed keys if you want to avoid storing plaintext keys.

I'll run through our suggested activation steps below and propose owners:
1) Create tenant namespace (Redwood): owner — David Kim.
2) Seed admin users (Orchid): owner — Eliza / Miguel. Redwood will invite via console and send join links.
3) Provision service account + API key (Redwood): owner — David Kim.
4) Map roles & scopes per spreadsheet (joint): owner — Irene Choi (SE) + Miguel.
5) SAML/SCIM (if you opt in): owner — Irene Choi.

Ben, I'm looping you in for billing/commit details and to note that Orchid is on the expansion track (deal D-34921). David/Irene — can we do a quick sync at 3pm PT today? If not, tomorrow 10am works.

Thanks — I'll standby for the meeting invite.

— Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi all — I can take the tenant creation and API key provisioning. A few technical notes before the call so we can make the 30–45 minute session productive:

1) Namespace creation: I will provision a staging namespace under org-id ORCH-34921-stg. Login admin will be monica@redwood.com unless you supply a specific Orchid admin email to seed.

2) API keys: We can do one of the following: a) single env key, b) per-service keys, or c) KMS-backed service account with never-exposed secrets (recommended for ingestion pipelines). If you want KMS, please share your KMS provider and ARN/Key ID.

3) Service account scopes: for ingestion we only need token:create, inference:invoke, logs:write. If you require dataset management scopes we'll expand accordingly.

4) SAML: I skimmed the SAML guide (SAML_Config_Guide.pdf) you attached during the meeting — if you plan to enable SSO now, bring your IdP metadata to the call and Irene will walk through assertions and group mappings.

5) Attachments/Artifacts: I'll push an empty test API key to the console during the call so Orchid can exercise a simple /v1/generate request. That key will be rotated after validation.

Agenda for 3pm PT call:
- 5m intros & success criteria
- 10m namespace & admin invite flow
- 15m API key/service account provisioning + test request
- 10m role mapping & SAML next steps
- 5m actions & owners

If 3pm works I'll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read and a link to a temporary test workspace.

Thanks,
David
